主要内容: On March 31, 2022, Mr. Stewart Koenigsberg informed Impac Mortgage Holdings, Inc. that he will not be standing for re-election at the Company’s 2022 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, scheduled for June 21, 2022. Mr. Koenigsberg was elected to the Board of Directors in 2018 and currently serves on the audit and governance and nomination committees. He will continue to serve on those committees for the remainder of his term.
